verdict.rationale: Cloudflare documents its own mechanism to "Intercept and handle outbound HTTP from sandboxes using Workers," which gives programmable control over egress, but the evidence is a single guide-index line. It is HTTP-scoped, and no declarative allow/deny policy is shown. A community comment that outbound control seems "all or nothing" is a tentative impression, not a concrete contradiction, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. missing for 10: explicit declarative allow/deny egress policy (domains/IPs/ports), coverage of non-HTTP egress, in-depth docs showing how to configure it, independent hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can restrict or allow the sandbox's network egress with explicit policy

citations.quote: Intercept and handle outbound HTTP from sandboxes using Workers.
